content:
FINAL PHASE — IVX ENTERPRISE USER EXPERIENCE CERTIFICATION

The backend is largely stabilized.

Now execute the FINAL USER EXPERIENCE CERTIFICATION.

Do NOT build new features.

Do NOT redesign the application.

Perfect the existing application.

===================================
PHASE 1 — LIVE DATA CONSISTENCY
===================================

Every module must display identical production data.

Landing
Home
Invest
Reels
Properties
JV Deals
Members
Investors
Portfolio
Notifications
Messages
Profile
Owner Dashboard
Admin Hub

No module may show stale data.

===================================
PHASE 2 — ZERO LOADING EXPERIENCE
===================================

Remove visible loading delays.

Implement:

• optimistic rendering
• stale-while-revalidate
• memory cache
• image prefetch
• React Query hydration
• pagination
• incremental rendering
• background refresh

No blank screens.

No flashing.

No spinner loops.

===================================
PHASE 3 — REELS STABILITY
===================================

Run 500 continuous open/close cycles.

Run:

scroll
pause
resume
background
foreground
network loss
network restore
orientation changes

Memory leak must equal zero.

No crash.

No duplicate videos.

No frozen player.

===================================
PHASE 4 — IMAGE PIPELINE
===================================

Every investment card:

prefetch images

lazy load

decode before display

cached thumbnails

high resolution on demand

No jumping.

No layout shift.

===================================
PHASE 5 — DATABASE SYNC
===================================

Verify every CRUD operation.

Create

Edit

Delete

Publish

Unpublish

Reorder

Upload media

Upload reels

Upload documents

Verify propagation:

Database

API

Landing

Mobile

Admin

Owner

===================================
PHASE 6 — OFFLINE RECOVERY
===================================

Simulate:

wifi off

4G

slow connection

timeouts

server restart

CloudFront cache

API restart

Every module must recover automatically.

===================================
PHASE 7 — SECURITY
===================================

Verify every protected route.

Owner

Admin

Member

Investor

Buyer

Guest

No privilege escalation.

===================================
PHASE 8 — PERFORMANCE
===================================

Measure:

FPS

Memory

CPU

JS thread

Render thread

Bundle size

Image size

API latency

Largest Contentful Paint

Time To Interactive

===================================
PHASE 9 — DESIGN CONSISTENCY
===================================

Verify every screen uses:

Official IVX logo

Official IVX colors

Official IVX typography

Official IVX spacing

Official buttons

Official icons

Official cards

No legacy logos.

No mixed branding.

===================================
PHASE 10 — FINAL ENTERPRISE REPORT
===================================

Return:

GitHub SHA

Render Runtime SHA

APK Version

CloudFront Version

Supabase Status

API Health

Image Pipeline

Video Pipeline

Reels

Landing

Authentication

Members

Investors

Owner

Performance

Memory

Security

Every module:

PASS

PARTIAL

FAIL

For every FAIL provide:

Exact file

Exact function

Root cause

Fix applied

Evidence

Live proof

Do not certify production until every critical module is verified with evidence.
